title: The Secret Sharer
summary: A young, inexperienced captain commands a ship on the China Seas and discovers a murderous stowaway in his cabin. The two men forge an intimate bond as the captain hides him from discovery, grappling with themes of identity, guilt, and moral responsibility. As they navigate treacherous waters together, the captain must confront his own hidden self while struggling to maintain command and control over both his ship and his conscience.
